exec: test("Ten starter ids", () => {expect(res.getStatus()).to.equal(200); var pool = res.getBody().pool; expect(pool).to.have.lengthOf(10); bru.setVar("starterPool", JSON.stringify(pool)); bru.setVar("starter1", pool[0]); bru.setVar("starter2", pool[1]); bru.setVar("starter3", pool[2]);});

test("Starters granted and run opened", () => {expect(res.getStatus()).to.equal(201); var b = res.getBody(); bru.setVar("runId", b.run_id); bru.setVar("owned1", b.starters[0].owned_id); bru.setVar("owned2", b.starters[1].owned_id); bru.setVar("owned3", b.starters[2].owned_id);});

test("Active run at stage 1", () => {expect(res.getStatus()).to.equal(200); var r = res.getBody(); expect(r.run_id).to.equal(bru.getVar("runId")); expect(r.status).to.equal("active"); expect(r.stage).to.equal(1); expect(r.wins_in_stage).to.equal(0); expect(r.boss_available).to.equal(false); expect(r.bosses_defeated).to.eql([]); expect(r.ended_at).to.equal(null);});
test("Page with the run", () => {expect(res.getStatus()).to.equal(200); var b = res.getBody(); expect(b.items).to.have.lengthOf(1); expect(b.page).to.equal(0); expect(b.total_items).to.equal(1);});

test("Run detail of the player", () => {expect(res.getStatus()).to.equal(200); var b = res.getBody(); expect(b.run_id).to.equal(bru.getVar("runId")); expect(b.status).to.equal("active"); expect(b.stage).to.equal(1);});

test("Three normal templates of stage 1", () => {expect(res.getStatus()).to.equal(200); var t = res.getBody(); expect(t.map(x => x.template_id)).to.eql([11, 12, 13]); t.forEach(x => {expect(x.is_boss).to.equal(false); expect(x.level_min).to.equal(1); expect(x.level_max).to.equal(3); expect(x.rarity_weights.common).to.equal(100);});});

test("Template detail", () => {expect(res.getStatus()).to.equal(200); var b = res.getBody(); expect(b.template_id).to.equal(11); expect(b.is_boss).to.equal(false); expect(b).to.include.keys("element", "level_min", "level_max", "rarity_weights");});
